personal.bio:
I'm Abdulkarim, a senior full-stack engineer based in Addis Ababa, shipping software for clients around the world for 5+ years. On Upwork I'm Top Rated Plus with a 100% Job Success score: $60K+ earned across 26 jobs.

Since June 2025 I've been building AIVI, a platform of AI voice agents and CRM for lending, insurance and contact centers. I was brought in to make the backend properly multi-tenant on Supabase, and my scope kept growing from there. Today I work across the backend, frontend, DevOps, security and SOC 2: multi-region cells, a micro-frontend platform, voice-guided co-browsing, and a reinforcement-learning policy that learns from call quality. That's 500+ merged PRs so far.

Before that I rebuilt Svetness's legacy system as Supabase microservices with a Next.js front end, led the frontend of Aladia's learning platform, trained frontier LLMs for Google through Turing, and built a real-time call-center platform for Canal+. I also founded Eaglix Tech, an agency that brings Ethiopian engineers to enterprise software and AI work.

Off the clock you'll find me at the chessboard or in central midfield.
